cohort: 2,892 multiparous women with TOLAC and 56,301 nulliparous women at 37 0/7 to 41 6/7 weeks of gestation
finding: Labor duration for TOLAC was slower compared to nulliparous labor, particularly for induced labor.
mod_finding: Labor duration for women attempting vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (TOLAC) was slower compared to nulliparous labor, especially for induced labor.
